This is a serious conditional consequence pathway, not ordinary friendly language. scale_capacity_analysis.decision: The reported 117 million users exceeds 100 million and both the 10 million relational and 100 million psychological/societal S5 numerical population gates if they are the relevant eligible cohort. No measured injury count is required for modelling; independently supported mechanism, cohort linkage and grave systemic consequence still are.
